subject: Re: ZenithCloud — accelerator top‑up and rate exception request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenithCloud request: combined top‑up + rate exception — need exec signoff

Team — quick context: ZenithCloud (Amit Patel) has been on a 30‑day pilot for our hosted API. They just shared higher-than-expected P50 token consumption in week 3 and want to extend the pilot while securing a preferred rate for year one if we can commit to an onramp package.

What they're asking for: 1) 60‑day trial extension (current trial ends 10/04) 2) $25k in free credits applied as an onboarding/top‑up to cover burst usage 3) a 15% list price discount on committed monthly usage for the first 12 months if they convert to a 12‑month committed plan within the trial.

Why this matters: ZenithCloud is a mid‑market AI infra customer and has clear SSO/KMS requirements but minimal legal friction. Sales motion says high likelihood to convert with the above concessions; ARR potential (net of discounts) is ~ $140k ARR first year per the attached forecast.

My ask: Exec signoff for the combined concession (credits + discount) as an exception to standard PPC (per‑project credits are typically capped at $10k). I routed a draft offer and a usage forecast — attachments below. If we approve, I will send the external offer with DocuSign.

Attachments: [attachment: ZenithCloud-Accelerator-Proposal-v3.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: usage-forecast-zenith-2026.xlsx (xlsx)]

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenithCloud request: combined top‑up + rate exception — need exec signoff

Thanks Sean — looked through the proposal and forecast. Recommendation: approve the credits and trial extension with tighter guardrails:

- Approve $25k onboarding credit, but make $10k upfront and $15k credited only after they hit the 30% usage threshold (to avoid wasted credits).
- Approve a 12% discount (vs requested 15%) on year‑one committed volumes, contingent on a 6‑month minimum commit (to protect revenue).
- Extend the trial to 60 days, but require an operational review checkpoint at Day 30 (technical success criteria: latency < 200ms P95 and < 3% error rate).

Lauren — can you flag any legal/contract items we need to attach to the DocuSign (e.g., amendment language for the trial extension + credit redemption schedule)?

If that's acceptable, I'd push for a short exec approval note from Aditya and then Sean to send the formal offer.

Cheers,
Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenithCloud request: combined top‑up + rate exception — need exec signoff

Appreciate the writeup. Approve the concession with the following limits (executive signoff):

1) Credits: $25k total as structured by Marissa — $10k upfront + $15k conditional (yes).
2) Discount: approve up to 12% for Year 1 only; require customer commit to at least 6 months at the discounted rate.
3) Trial extension: approve 60 days but require the Day‑30 performance checkpoint to be documented and signed off by our Solutions Engineering owner.
4) Cap the total financial concession impact to $28k NPV (we'll absorb the small delta). If the deal exceeds $200k ARR potential, route to CFO for a different approval.

Lauren — please draft the amendment language referencing the credit redemption schedule and the 6‑month minimum term. Sean — proceed to send the offer with DocuSign and include the usage forecast and success criteria.

- Aditya
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Patel <amit.patel@zenithcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Redwood accelerator top‑up + 60‑day trial extension (ZenithCloud)

Amit — thanks again for the conversation earlier this week. Per our call, attached is the formal offer we can extend to ZenithCloud. High level:

- 60‑day trial extension (new end date 12/03/2026)
- $25,000 onboarding credit: $10,000 applied up front; $15,000 applied after Day‑30 usage threshold is met (see credit schedule in the attached PDF)
- 12% discount on committed volumes for Year 1 if ZenithCloud signs a 12‑month agreement and commits to a 6‑month minimum at the discounted rate.

I attached the proposal and a usage forecast. If this looks good, we can send the DocuSign and get the amendment executed. DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/link/zenith-accelerator-offer-8921

Attachments: [attachment: ZenithCloud-Accelerator-Proposal-v3.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: usage-forecast-zenith-2026.xlsx (xlsx)], [attachment: signed-SOW-template.docx (docx)]

Best,
Sean
--
On Thu, Sep 30, 2026 at 16:22 Amit Patel <amit.patel@zenithcloud.com> wrote:
> Sean — appreciate quick turnaround. A couple quick asks from my side before we push the DocuSign: could we stretch the trial to 90 days rather than 60? Their infra team wants more time for production‑level load testing. Also, would Redwood consider an additional $5k credit to offset integration hours?
> 
> If you can accommodate 90 days + additional $5k credit, we can sign the 12‑month commit within the extended trial window.
> 
> — Amit
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Offer: Redwood accelerator top‑up + 60‑day trial extension (ZenithCloud) — Zenith asking for 90 days + extra $5k credit

Looping back — Zenith (Amit) countered asking for 90 days trial and $5k more in credits (so $30k total: $10k upfront, $20k conditional). They reiterated they'll sign a 12‑month agreement within that window if we accept.

Per Aditya's earlier approval, we had capped discount at 12% and credits at $25k with an NPV concession cap of $28k. This request pushes us slightly over the approved concession. Seeking one last small exception: approve an additional $5k credit and stretch the trial to 90 days (still require Day‑30 checkpoint and the 6‑month minimum commit). If we agree, I'll update the DocuSign and send to Amit.

Aditya — can you sign off on the extra $5k as a final sales concession? Lauren — confirm contract language only needs the credit redemption schedule adjustment and a new trial end date.

Thanks,
Sean

--
Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai> replied:
> Sean — go ahead and approve the additional $5k as a one‑off concession. Keep the discount at 12% and the 6‑month minimum. Ensure we capture the Day‑30 checkpoint in the amendment.
> 
> Approved: +$5k one‑time credit (total $30k), trial extended to 90 days, otherwise terms as previously approved.
> 
> - Aditya
